steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each job waits for the one before it on the critical path. A job with no permit or owner is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Job with no permit
findings.fix: Get the permit before the job starts

findings.title: Critical-path resource with no named owner

pros: Checks a job with no duration, a job with no permit, and a resource needed on the critical path with no named owner.
cons: Not checked: Whether the estimates are right.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ind-shutdown-plan skill on the records for this review.
